description_zh: 调用EnableActiveMetricRule接口启用一键报警规则
name: EnableActiveMetricRule

parameters.help_en:
The name of the Alibaba Cloud service that supports one-click alert rules. Valid values:

ecs: Elastic Compute Service (ECS).
rds: ApsaraDB RDS.
slb: Server Load Balancer (SLB).
redis_standard: Standard architecture of open-source Redis.
redis_sharding: Cluster architecture of open-source Redis.
redis_splitrw: Read/write splitting architecture of open-source Redis.
mongodb: ApsaraDB for MongoDB (replica set).
mongodb_sharding: ApsaraDB for MongoDB (sharded cluster).
hbase: ApsaraDB for HBase.
elasticsearch: Elasticsearch.
opensearch: OpenSearch
parameters.help_zh:
支持一键报警规则的云服务名称。取值：

ecs：云服务器ECS。
rds：云数据库RDS版。
slb：负载均衡。
redis_standard：Redis 开源版标准架构。
redis_sharding：Redis 开源版集群架构。
redis_splitrw：Redis 开源版读写分离架构。
mongodb：云数据库MongoDB版（副本集）。
mongodb_sharding：云数据库MongoDB版（分片集群）。
hbase：云数据库HBase版。
elasticsearch：Elasticsearch。
opensearch：OpenSearch
parameters.name: product

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to check the availability of the webhook
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can generate the value of this parameter on the client side. Make sure that the value is unique across different requests. The value can be up to 64 ASCII characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token
